# Pitchside

> Pitchside is a web app for football (soccer) clubs and coaches. It combines a squad database, a skill-rating system and an interactive tactics board in one place. Available in English, German and Arabic (right-to-left).

## What it does
- Squad management: store player profiles (contact details, club, photo) and search the squad.
- Player evaluation: rate each player from 1 to 5 on technical, physical, tactical and mental skills; see averages and rankings on a dashboard.
- Tactics board: place home/away players, ball, cones and goals on a full pitch, half pitch, penalty box or blank pitch; draw runs, passes, dribbles and zones; load formations such as 4-4-2, 4-3-3, 3-5-2; undo/redo; export as PNG.
- Plans: save boards as tactical plans, filter by manager, reopen and edit later.

## Pricing
- The tactics designer (/en/designer, /de/designer, /ar/designer) is free and needs no account.
- The full club management system (players, ratings, cloud-saved plans, coach invitations, share links) is in early access: ask for it through the contact page (/en/contact, /de/contact, /ar/contact).

## Pages (public)
- English: /en and /en/features
- Deutsch: /de and /de/features
- العربية: /ar and /ar/features

The signed-in application (dashboard, players, tactics, plans) requires an account and is not crawlable.

## Technical
- Frontend: Next.js (App Router, server-rendered, localized routes). Backend: Django REST API with PostgreSQL.
